finalization_environment.source_scope: src, scripts, ui and tests Python files; project/lock metadata in ZIP

generation_measurement_limit: Successful final generation invocation has sampled process-tree peak RSS. The deliberately killed invocation has only a point RSS observation, not a saved peak; no complete peak or total wall-time measurement across that crash is claimed.

resumed_from.note: Per-shard normalization checkpoints reused; input SHA256 rechecked after pause. Scan times are accumulated completed-shard times across invocations; current invocation wall time also includes revalidation of completed shards.

concurrency_conditions: During the resumed scan, small local regression/AppTest validation, header-only accounting and an NCAR LIST/HEAD metadata dry-run ran independently. No isolated-idle-host timing or controlled OS-cache claim. The benchmark RSS covers its own process tree.

acceptance.scope: synthetic scale only; sampled RSS, interrupted generator peak unavailable; OS cache uncontrolled; no real-200GB claim
